content:
maya: FYI we had a burst of invoke.validation hits this morning for fncall traffic in eu-west. about 12% fallback to degen models, users saw higher cost.
liam: saw alert. any obvious culprit? particular model_variant or route tag?
maya: mostly /v1/chat with fncall=true, small seq lengths but mixed tool payload shapes.
olga: console shows spike at ~04:10 UTC. I can add a stacked breakdown by validation mode (strict vs soft).
rory: current telemetry just emits `validation_reason: schema_mismatch` which is too coarse. we need finer categories like arrays vs missing props vs type mismatches.
liam: agree. also include route_id and model_variant in the event so dashboards can filter.
paul: and include fallback_reason when a fallback happened so cost can be attributed.
maya: proposed fields: `validation_category` in ["missing_field","type_mismatch","unexpected_array","extra_root"], `validation_mode` in ["strict","soft"], plus `route_id` and `model`. sample payloads at 0.1% into secure project for debugging.
olga: console work: 1) add a panel for validation_category split; 2) heatmap of rate by route_id; 3) cost overlay showing fallback volume. need exact metric names.
rory: propose namespace `invoke.validation.v1` with event fields `category`, `mode`, `route_id`, `model`, `customer_tier`, `kvcache_hit`. keeps consistent with invoke.latency metrics.
liam: current alert pages on >5% rejects in 10m which was noisy. what alerting change do we want?
paul: noisy because soft rejects counted same as hard. change alert to page only for `mode=="strict"` or for categories [missing_field, unexpected_array]. treat other validation as SLO burn not pager.
maya: rollout plan: (1) telemetry schema changes (rory) (2) console panels + annotation (olga) (3) alert rule update + runbook tweak (paul + sres) (4) support/SE FAQ (maya) (5) default soft-validate for hosted canary for 7d then re-evaluate.
liam: sampling note: 0.1% payload sampling could be large for heavy routes. can we do dynamic per-route reservoir sampling?
rory: yes, implement per-route reservoir with caps. default 0.05% but for routes <1k reqs/day bump to 1%. do this in the telemetry client.
olga: UX ask: add a toggle in console to view historical charts in strict vs soft mode and a quick pivot to affected customer list (not payloads) to preserve privacy.
maya: privacy: sampled payloads go to secure internal project, redaction pipeline runs, and we tag events `sensitivity: pii_filtered`.
paul: mitigation: temporarily raise the routing degen threshold in eu-west so small blips don't auto-degen. keep strict canary for premium tenants.
liam: cautious: changing routing thresholds can hide regressions. only do per-customer threshold bumps for low-SLA tenants.
maya: compromise: global degen threshold 10% -> 20% for 30m in eu-west while telemetry lands; do NOT change premium canary behavior. auto rollback after window.
rory: opening PR with schema changes + unit tests. example event: ```json
{"metric":"invoke.validation.v1","category":"missing_field","mode":"soft","route_id":"chat:default","model":"redwood-v1","count":1}
```
olga: dashboard draft posted https://console.internal/d/634/validation-errors with category panel; will add annotation for 04:00-04:30 UTC.
liam: add console annotation for spike window so folks see context.
paul: changing pager to only strict/high-severity, runbook updated to check validation_category and fallback_reason first.
maya: action items: rory PR + tests; olga dashboard + annotation; paul update alerting + runbook; liam coordinate rollout throttle; maya publish support note & SLA exception list. will update when PRs land. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry/agent v3.14 -> 04:45 UTC
rory: PR opened https://git.internal/r/telemetry/+/2349 (includes schema tests).
olga: dashboard draft link above; feedback welcome.
liam: solid iteration, keep rollback plan.
maya: resolving for now, will reopen if noise persists.
